welcome.title: Set up JoyoFit
welcome.intro: JoyoFit works with your Huawei or Honor watch directly, without Huawei Health. This guide takes a few minutes and you can skip any step.
welcome.before1: Have the watch next to you, charged and awake.
welcome.before3: Know which phone or app the watch is paired with now. A watch accepts one app at a time, so it has to be released there first.
welcome.covers1: Releasing the watch from Huawei Health, and keeping your old history.
welcome.covers2: Pairing; the first sync then runs by itself in the background.
welcome.covers3Android: Permissions: notifications, Health Connect, weather, staying connected.
welcome.covers4: Signing in with JoyoRogo, which is optional.
welcome.reopen: You can open this guide again any time from More, Setup guide.

noWatch.title: No watch yet, or your watch isn't supported?
noWatch.body: That is fine. Strength logging, Coach and the exercise library work fully without a watch. You can connect one later from More, Watch.
noWatch.button: I don't have a watch / my watch isn't supported yet

unbind.title: Release the watch from Huawei Health
unbind.intro: A Huawei or Honor watch talks to one app at a time. While Huawei Health holds it, the watch refuses JoyoFit.
unbind.step1: Open Huawei Health and pull down on its first screen to sync once more. Anything that is only on the watch and not yet in your Huawei account is lost when you unbind.
unbind.step2: Optional: keep your history. Huawei can send everything Huawei Health stored as a ZIP file, which JoyoFit imports on this phone. It can take up to 7 days to arrive, so request it now and import it whenever it comes.
unbind.step3: In Huawei Health, open the watch under Devices and unbind (remove) it. If it is still connected to another phone, disconnect it there too.
unbind.showImport: Request or import my Huawei Health history
unbind.note: Not sure the unbind worked? Go on: pairing tells you if the watch still refuses. Importing later is always possible from More, Import from Huawei Health.

pair.title: Pair your watch
pair.intro: Wake the watch and keep it next to the phone. JoyoFit looks for it as soon as Bluetooth is allowed; the first time, the watch asks you to confirm on its own screen.
pair.connected: Connected. The first sync runs in the background while you finish setting up.
pair.help: Check that it is unbound from Huawei Health and not connected to another phone or app, that it is awake and close, and try Connect again. If it still refuses after a restart of the watch, a reset of the watch from its own Settings is the last resort. A reset erases the data stored on the watch (workouts and days that were never synced), so sync first if you can, and do not start here.
pair.keepAwake: Keep the watch awake. When its screen asks to pair, accept it on the watch. This can take up to a minute.
pair.keepAwakeIos: Keep the watch awake. When its screen asks to pair, accept it on the watch, then tap Pair if iOS shows its pairing request. This can take up to a minute.

scan.keepClose: Keep the watch awake and next to the phone.

confirm.title: Tap ✓ on your watch
confirm.helpAwake: Wake the watch and keep its screen on: the request only shows on a lit screen.
confirm.helpNear: Hold the watch right next to the phone.
confirm.helpUnpaired: Check that Huawei Health, or another phone, no longer holds the watch. Unbind it there, then tap Connect again.
confirm.helpIos: Also look for the iPhone's Bluetooth pairing request and tap Pair.

manual.title: Add manually
manual.none: No model matches. A Huawei or Honor watch that is not listed is still tried: close this list and scan.
manual.prompt: Pick your model to see how to put it in pairing mode. JoyoFit then scans again and marks your watch.

mode.title: Pairing mode
mode.huaweiWatch: A watch that is ready to pair shows a pairing screen (a QR code or its Bluetooth name) once its language is chosen. If it shows its normal watch face, it is still paired with a phone: unbind it in Huawei Health first, which usually resets it to that screen.
mode.huaweiBand: A band that is ready to pair shows a pairing screen once it is switched on and its language is chosen. If it shows the time, it is still paired with a phone: unbind it in Huawei Health first. Bands do not appear in the phone's Bluetooth settings; only JoyoFit's scan finds them.
mode.honor: Honor watches and bands work like Huawei ones: a pairing screen once the language is chosen. One that shows the time is still paired and has to be unbound in Honor Health or Huawei Health first. The newest Honor watches (Watch 5 and later) cannot be paired yet.
mode.then: Then keep it next to the phone: it appears as a card here when the scan sees it.
mode.thenIos: Then keep it next to the iPhone: it appears as a card here when the list sees it.

firstSync.running: Reading the history from your watch in the background. You can carry on.
firstSync.done: History from the watch is in.
firstSync.doneCounts: History from the watch is in. Workouts: {{workouts}} · Sleep segments: {{sleep}} · Activity samples: {{samples}}.
firstSync.failed: The first sync stopped: {{error}}. Sync later from More, Watch, or pull down on Today.
firstSync.failedNoReason: The first sync stopped. Sync later from More, Watch, or pull down on Today.

notifications.title: Notifications on the watch
notifications.introIos: The watch shows your iPhone notifications itself, over Bluetooth. iOS only shares them once you allow it for the watch.
notifications.introAndroid: JoyoFit can show your phone notifications on the watch. Android asks you to grant notification access to JoyoFit first.
notifications.iosNotice: On the iPhone open Settings, Bluetooth, tap the i next to your watch and turn on Show Notifications. Which apps appear is chosen in iPhone Settings, Notifications.

health.title: Share with {{store}}
health.intro: JoyoFit can write your steps, heart rate, blood oxygen, sleep and workouts to {{store}} after every sync, so other apps such as JoyoRogo can read them. Nothing is shared until you switch it on and allow it.

weather.title: Weather on the watch
weather.intro: JoyoFit can send the forecast to the watch. It needs this phone's location, or you can pick a city and share no location at all.

background.title: Stay connected in the background
background.intro: With this on, JoyoFit keeps the watch connected and syncs on a timer while the app is closed, so Today is current when you open it.
background.notice: Some phones (Huawei, Honor, Xiaomi, Oppo, Vivo, Samsung and others) stop background apps to save battery. If the watch keeps disconnecting while the screen is off, open JoyoFit's app settings, go to Battery and choose Unrestricted or No restrictions.

account.title: Sign in with JoyoRogo
account.intro: JoyoRogo is our food diary: photograph a meal and it counts the calories. Signing in connects the two apps. JoyoFit works fully without an account.
account.gives1: Your daily Recovery, Strain and Sleep scores appear next to what you ate in the JoyoRogo diary, with a short food tip for a day like this.
account.gives2: What you log in JoyoRogo can show on the watch's calorie card.
account.gives3: The option of a cloud backup of your watch data, which is part of JoyoRogo Pro (the next step).
account.note: While you are signed in, JoyoFit sends your daily scores and body metrics (sleep, resting heart rate, HRV, VO2max) to JoyoRogo and exchanges meals and weight with it. Your watch data stays on this phone unless you turn on the Pro cloud backup. Sign out any time in More, Health and cloud.

pro.title: JoyoRogo Pro
pro.intro: JoyoFit is free to use in full: pairing, sync, workouts and the health apps all work on this phone without paying. Pro is an optional plan on your JoyoRogo account.
pro.adds1: Cloud backup of your watch data (steps, heart rate, blood oxygen, sleep and workouts) to your own JoyoRogo account. JoyoFit uploads it today; restoring it into the app is not built yet.
pro.adds2: Meal suggestions in JoyoRogo built from today's JoyoFit scores. Without Pro the diary shows a short hint instead.
pro.managed: JoyoRogo Pro is managed in the JoyoRogo app.
pro.active: Cloud backup is on for this account.
pro.locked: This account is not on Pro, so nothing is uploaded. Everything else works as before.
pro.signInFirst: Pro belongs to your JoyoRogo account. Sign in in the previous step to use it.

price.lineWithRise: {{prices}}. The monthly price is an introductory one and rises to {{next}} once the intro places are taken.

scans.both: Up to {{pro}} AI meal scans a day in JoyoRogo, instead of {{free}}.
scans.pro: Up to {{pro}} AI meal scans a day in JoyoRogo.
scans.generic: A much higher daily limit of AI meal scans in JoyoRogo.

cloud.title: JoyoRogo Cloud
cloud.intro: Every workout from the watch is backed up to your JoyoRogo account, viewable at joyorogo.com/jam, and moves with you to a new phone. If you lose your phone, your history is not lost.
cloud.whyTitle: Why not just Health Connect or Apple Health?
cloud.whyIntro: Health Connect and Apple Health keep raw records on the device. That is useful, but JoyoRogo Cloud keeps more:
cloud.why1: The analysis is saved too: splits per kilometre, heart-rate zones, best efforts, training effect, VO2max and recovery time.
cloud.why2: There is a web view at joyorogo.com/jam, with no need to open the app.
cloud.why3: It restores onto a new phone after you sign in, including between Android and iPhone.
cloud.backup: Back up workouts to the cloud
cloud.backupHint: Old and new workouts upload automatically after a watch sync.
cloud.wifiOnlyHint: Uploads wait for Wi-Fi so they do not use mobile data.
cloud.backupOn: Backup is on. Workouts already on this phone are uploaded in the background; you do not need to wait here.
cloud.backupOff: Backup is off. Workouts stay on this phone. You can turn it back on in More, Cloud sync.
cloud.free: Workout cloud is a JoyoRogo Pro feature. Your account is not on Pro, so workouts stay on this phone only and everything keeps working as usual. If you get Pro later, existing workouts are uploaded too.
cloud.managedStore: JoyoRogo Pro is managed in the JoyoRogo app.
cloud.signIn: Sign in with your JoyoRogo account to use the cloud, or skip. JoyoFit works fully without an account.

done.title: You are set up
done.intro: JoyoFit keeps syncing on its own from here. A few places worth knowing:
done.reopen: Open this guide again from More, Setup guide.

today.title: Today
today.text: Steps, heart rate, sleep and your Recovery, Strain and Readiness scores. Pull down to sync.

workouts.title: Workouts
workouts.text: Every workout recorded on the watch, with its route and a card to share.

strava.title: Strava
strava.text: More, Strava: send watch workouts to Strava, free while slots are spare.

findWatch.title: Find my watch
findWatch.text: More, Watch: make the watch ring when it is lost in the house.

strength.title: Training
strength.text: On Today: Start workout, or pick a routine. History, calendar and records are in the Workouts tab.

coach.title: Coach
coach.text: A training plan and a daily suggestion on Today. Answer "How does your body feel today?" so the suggestion fits.

library.title: Exercise library
library.text: How to do each move, with pictures, from the card on Today.

watchLater.title: A watch, any time
watchLater.text: More, Watch: pair a Huawei or Honor watch, or request support for yours.

done.introNoWatch: Today is ready to use, no watch needed. A few places worth knowing:

phone.title: Training without a watch
phone.intro: Everything you need to train is already on this phone.
phone.logger: Log strength workouts: sets, reps, weight, rest timer and personal records. Calories come from your body weight and how long you trained.
phone.coach: Coach (Pro) builds a training plan and a daily suggestion. With no watch data, the suggestion uses your plan and how you say you feel today.
phone.library: An exercise library with pictures and how to do each move.
phone.rogo: JoyoRogo: your workout calories go to your food diary.
phone.weightIntro: Your body weight is used to estimate workout calories. You can skip it; the estimate then uses 70 kg.
phone.weightSaved: Saved: {{kg}} kg. Height and birth year can be added in More, Profile.
phone.weightInvalid: Enter a weight between 20 and 300 kg.
phone.later: Got a Huawei or Honor watch later? Pair it from More, Watch any time, without repeating this guide.
